Who We Are

Compliance First. Craftsmanship Always.

Giles Electrical Services is a Texas-based electrical subcontractor working alongside general contractors, developers and property owners on commercial, residential and industrial projects.

From the first conduit stub-up to the final panel directory, we run disciplined crews that respect the drawings, the schedule and the inspector. Our foremen read plans, coordinate with other trades and document every phase so your close-out package is clean.

State LicensedLicensed electrical contractor through the Texas Department of Licensing and Regulation (TDLR). License TECL #00000.
Fully InsuredGeneral liability and workers' compensation coverage in force. Certificate of insurance available on request.
Code CompliantInstallations per the National Electrical Code (NEC) and local amendments. We schedule and pass our own inspections.
Safety CultureOSHA-trained crews, daily safety briefings and trench protocols on every underground job.
What We Do

Specialized Electrical Services

Three markets, one standard. Every project is built to code, documented and ready for inspection.

Commercial

Commercial Electrical

Ground-up and tenant-improvement electrical for retail, office, education, healthcare and multifamily projects.

  • Underground duct banks, conduit raceways and stub-ups
  • Electrical rooms, panelboards and switchboards
  • Feeders, branch circuits and lighting rough-in
  • Tenant finish-out and trim
Get a Commercial Bid
Residential

Residential Electrical

Clean, labeled, inspection-ready work for home builders, remodelers and homeowners.

  • Service upgrades and new load centers (200 A and up)
  • New-construction wiring, remodels and additions
  • EV charger, HVAC and water-heater circuits
  • Generator transfer switches and troubleshooting
Get a Residential Quote
Industrial

Industrial Power

Heavy-duty raceway, equipment feeds and controls for warehouses, plants and site infrastructure.

  • Equipment feeders, disconnects and distribution
  • Rigid conduit and strut support systems
  • Motor, control and VFD wiring
  • Site lighting and maintenance programs
Discuss an Industrial Project

How We Work

A Clean Process From Bid to Close-Out

Predictable communication and documentation at every milestone, so you always know where the electrical scope stands.

Send the Drawings

Share plans, specs and schedule. We review scope, flag conflicts early and confirm what the AHJ will require.

Detailed Bid

Itemized proposal with materials, labor, exclusions and a phased schedule. Target turnaround: 24 hours on standard scopes.

Mobilize & Build

Licensed crews on site with a dedicated foreman, daily reporting and coordination with every other trade.

Inspect & Close Out

We schedule inspections, walk them with the inspector and deliver as-builts, panel directories and warranty docs.
